request: Build me a rental contracts module with lines, statuses and a board.

outcome.renderedDiff:
Publishes Board “Rental contract board” for Rental contract. Stages are Draft, Active, Overdue, Returned, Cancelled. Available moves are Activate, Cancel, Mark overdue, Mark returned, Mark returned late. Card facts are Start date, End date, Deposit.
New record type "Rental contract" with 6 fields:
  - State (one of "Draft", "Active", "Overdue", "Returned", "Cancelled", required)
  - Contract name (text, required)
  - Start date (date, required)
  - End date (date)
  - Deposit (whole number)
  - Notes (text)
  It gets its own menu entry "Rental contract" with a list, a record page and a form.
  People who can use the rest of the application can create, change, archive and restore Rental contract records.
New line table "Rental lines" on Rental contract:
  - Line number (whole number, required)
  - Rented item (text, required)
  - Quantity (whole number, required)
  - Daily rate (whole number)
  - Returned (yes or no)
New optional link "Customer" from Rental contract to Party. Choose it when creating a record.
New lifecycle for Rental contract. Records start at "Draft".
  - Activate changes "Draft" to "Active" after confirmation.
  - Mark overdue changes "Active" to "Overdue" after confirmation.
  - Mark returned changes "Active" to "Returned" after confirmation.
  - Mark returned late changes "Overdue" to "Returned" after confirmation.
  - Cancel changes "Draft" to "Cancelled" after confirmation.

Stored data: 2 new tables, 2 addForeignKey x2, 4 new indexes. Nothing already stored is changed or removed.
Rolling back hides this change again and keeps every record entered under it.
